La solution TMS est une plateforme de gestion du transport haut de gamme, modulaire et évolutive, conçue pour accompagner les grandes entreprises face à la complexité croissante de leurs opérations. Elle permet de couvrir l’ensemble de la chaîne transport, de la prise de commande à la facturation, tout en intégrant des outils puissants d’optimisation des tournées, de suivi en temps réel et de pilotage de la performance. Elle se positionne comme une solution stratégique pour améliorer la rentabilité, renforcer la traçabilité et soutenir la transition écologique du transport. La solution s’adresse à des clients du secteur du transport, allant de PME historiques à de grands comptes internationaux. Objectifs et livrables EQUIPE ET METHODOLOGIE DE TRAVAIL : L’équipe est composée de 12 développeurs AS400 aux profils variés, mêlant experts confirmés et juniors, et met en avant l’esprit d’équipe ainsi que la collaboration au quotidien. Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android. Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities. Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility. Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing. Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes. Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance. Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal. Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations. Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store. Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team. Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem. Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications. Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management. Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior. Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software. A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents. The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions. Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly. The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team. Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached. Especially Valuable Experience GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data. BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection. UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility. NFC and other device-to-device interactions. Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling. Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience. Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects. Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies. The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature. Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development. Your earliest start date and salary expectations. Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.
